name: EdSurgery
title: Notaufnahme – Chirurgie
description: Surgery template for the emergency department: patient, history, examination and assessment of surgical patients. Every field and its target in FHIR R4 and the IPS (2.0) is listed in docs/mapping/ed-surgery.csv; the backend extracts the resources from that table. SDC extraction extensions are set where SDC can express the mapping (vital signs, symptoms, exam findings, lab values, Patient). All SNOMED CT and LOINC codes exist and are active (SNOMED CT International 2026-07-01, LOINC 2.83); the clinical fit of new codes is still to be confirmed by area 3. Answers coded with pulsenote-local are placeholders.
